## 0.2.191

Opening an unread article beside the list no longer paints a second copy of the page across it: a
request htmx sends is now answered as a browser's, so the auto-mark on load and the read, star and
save buttons swap in their own button instead of a whole page, and so does the note editor's save.
Every boosted form in Settings, Administration, backup, devices and sign-in now gets the redirect a
plain form gets, so an error shows and a success is confirmed. A caller that sends neither
`Accept: text/html` nor `HX-Request` gets the same answers as before (a behaviour fix; nothing to
migrate or configure).
